items.Sentence: The headworks include a rotary hydroscreen system, a screenings washer, and a metering flume.

Wastewater from the headworks flows by gravity to the east end of the aeration pond...the third cell contains a 3-horsepower aerator, set on a timer, to create aerobic and anoxic conditions within the pond.
The settling pond (also known as the North Pond) is used for storage during high flows and for filter backwashes...Wastewater from the settling pond is recirculated to the aeration pond as necessary.

Tertiary treatment is achieved in the microfiltration system. The microfiltration system consists of two treatment trains each with a holding tank, strainer, and three banks of 12 microza microfiltration modules (water flows from the outside-in).
To maintain cleanliness in the filters, the secondary effluent is pre-chlorinated using sodium hypochlorite prior to filtration.
Sodium hypochlorite is injected into the 8-inch influent line prior to entering the chlorine contact tank using an injection quill assembly.
After flowing through the chlorine contact tank, before discharge to the effluent storage pond, the chlorinated effluent is dechlorinated using sodium bisulfite.
After treatment, the advanced treated effluent is discharged to an on-site effluent storage pond prior to discharge to the recycled water system or the surface water discharge system.
Biosolids generated during the treatment process accumulate in the aeration and settling ponds, where they undergo anaerobic digestion and densification.
During the 2012 biosolids removal event, approximately 99 dry tons of solids were removed from the ponds and land applied by Synagro Technologies, Inc.
The settling pond (also known as the North Pond) is used for storage during high flows and for filter backwashes.
Wastewater from the aeration pond is pumped to the filtration system.
The cleaned and dewatered solids are disposed of at a landfill.
